name: Hubei Huitian New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Hubei Huitian New Materials Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of adhesives and new materials in China and internationally. It operates in two segments, Fine Chemicals and Solar Backsheets; and Photovoltaic Power Plants.
